experimental_method: Flow microcalorimetry (LKB twin-thermopile instrument): small gas volumes (water-saturated, from a syringe at 298.15 K) injected into a stream of de-aerated water at 288, 298 and 308 K; enthalpy of solution from the heat per mole of gas injected.
uncertainties_stated: Temperatures correct within 0.03 K; delta T for heat capacity < 0.01 K; atmospheric pressure within 20 Pa; electrical calibration better than 0.02 per cent; column s is the estimated standard deviation of individual enthalpies in each series; Table 2 (not extracted) gives 2s of the means.
quality_remarks: Authors state agreement with Benson and Krause for O2, Ar and rare gases, and with Dee and Gill for CH4, C2H6 etc. The He 298.09 K series 821222 prints 10^6 n_g = 17.182 whereas all other He series at 298 K print about 12.2 (kept as printed; possibly a misprint). Nominal T drifts (298.09 to 298.17 K, 308.13/308.15, 288.07/288.14), as printed. Pressure is the calorimeter total pressure (about 1.06e5 Pa), not a partial pressure.
earlier_run_files: No earlier files existed for this slug; the whole paper was done from scratch in this run.
